visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with dark brown hair, wearing a white floral qipao (cheongsam), stands in front of a white slatted shutter background. She has her hands together in a prayer position near her chest. Large pink lotus flowers and green leaves are digitally overlaid at the top and bottom of the frame. The lighting is bright and soft, creating a warm and professional studio atmosphere. (2) As she continues speaking, she gestures with her hands to emphasize her points, eventually holding up one finger, then two, and then three as a visual list. Her facial expressions are friendly and energetic, with constant eye contact with the camera. (3) The scene transitions to her explaining the first tip. She gestures towards her shoulders and back while speaking enthusiastically. The digital overlays of lotus flowers remain static at the bottom. (4) In this phase, she focuses on jewelry, gesturing towards her wrists where she wears several bracelets. She uses wide hand movements to describe energy flow. Her makeup is polished, and she wears large pink floral earrings. (5) She describes the third tip, forming an 'OK' sign with her fingers and moving her hands in circular patterns to represent incense or energy. The background remains a clean, bright studio setting with no visible furniture other than the shutters. (6) The final phase shows her giving two thumbs up and making a finger heart gesture. She smiles broadly, bows slightly with her hands together again in prayer position, and waves goodbye as the video ends.
